unanswered.author: alicia thomas
unanswered.snippet: Husband's 70th Birthday. Just came to chill and try the beer and food. Everything was off the chain great. We had Fish and Chips, seasoned fries cooked to perfection! The fish was meaty. Pulled Pork Tacos (2) BBQ style was amazing! The pulled pork was spot on!
unanswered.draftReply: Alicia, what a joy it was to help celebrate your husband's 70th! So glad the fish and chips and BBQ pulled pork tacos hit the spot -- that's exactly the kind of visit we love hosting. Happy belated birthday to him, and we can't wait to see you both again!
